## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5d96da2409462627c4799b9a9deab4ff251ff6fb`

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) Ordering condition — HOLDS.** `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rules/branches/main`, read in this act at 2026-09-27T15:49Z: ruleset `11776024`, one `required_status_checks` rule (`strict_required_status_checks_policy: true`) carrying 8 contexts — Lint, Type Check, Build & E2E, Build Docs, Changeset Declaration, Test, Spec Main Shape Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard. `Spec Main Shape Gate` is in the required set. The triage note `5852129691` read 7 at its time; the eighth, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, is outside this card. The enrolment preceded the PR (read back and recorded at 2026-09-27T02:58Z; the PR was opened later that day), which is the order the seat ruling `5750525995` prescribed: the source file never claims the gate is required before the setting is read back, and the maintainer's word 「Spec Main Shape Gate 已处理，其他同意」 is the provenance.

**(b) Latest check-run on the current `main` head — SUCCESS.** `main` is `6cf599985db2f021d53edcb2b1fa6837f1937461`; `GET /commits/6cf5999…/check-runs?filter=latest` lists `Spec Main Shape Gate` `completed` / `success` (run 36329428115, a `merge_group` build). The PR body's `dac022c4e` reading is older: `main` has moved 3 commits since the PR's base `bff63cc12`, none touching a file this PR changes (`mergeable_state: clean`).

**(c) Gate semantics — YES: it waits, and it refuses on red or absent; it cannot let a red or missing SMSG through, and there is no legitimate never-reports case to stall on.** Read from the code at head, not its comments. `evaluateGate` (`scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs:374-412`) iterates `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`; `classify()` (`:358-362`) returns `missing` for no run, `pending` for `status !== 'completed'`, and `not-green` for any `conclusion !== 'success'` (so `failure`, `cancelled` and `skipped` are all not green); the verdict is `red` if anything is failing, else `pending` if anything is pending or missing, else `green`. `waitForGate` (`:470-508`) returns only on a non-pending verdict and turns a still-pending gate at the deadline into `red` with `timedOut: true`; `dependabot-auto-merge.yml` runs approve and enqueue only under `if: steps.gate.outputs.gate == 'green'`. `createChecksApi` (`:419-457`) issues only `/repos/{repo}/commits/{sha}/check-runs`; nothing reads the ruleset, so ruleset membership never changes the gate's answer. The name is at `:242`. Reporting surface: `.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml` triggers `pull_request: branches: [main, develop]` with no `paths`, plus `merge_group` and `workflow_dispatch`, with no `continue-on-error`; `dependabot-auto-merge.yml` triggers on the identical `pull_request: branches: [main, develop]`, and `.github/dependabot.yml` sets no `target-branch`, so every pull request the gate judges also produces this check — it is neither path-filtered nor `merge_group`-only. Timing: the last 100 SMSG runs show `pull_request` median 12.1 min, max 13.3 min (58 successes, 34 `merge_group` successes, 3 cancelled superseded PR runs, 0 failures) against the gate's 2400-second deadline; a run slower than the deadline fails closed (timeout red), never open. Not measured by anyone, and I confirm it cannot be yet: SMSG has never run on a Dependabot-actor head (`runs?actor=dependabot[bot]` answers 0; no Dependabot PR has existed since the workflow was born on 2026-09-18). The workflow needs only `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` under `contents: read`, and if it did not run, the gate would time out red and merge nothing. Open Dependabot PRs at this reading: 0.

**(d) `WATCHED_CONTEXTS` is a report-only parameter of the existing patrol — YES, no new failing limb.** The header of `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` (`:13-15`) reserves exit 3 for a pinned context or a rule type gone; `:84-87` says `WATCHED_CONTEXTS` "is the rest of the live set, reported and never red"; `:110-114` names the accepted failure mode (a silent removal of a watched context is reported and does not fail anything) and makes promotion "a maintainer's call, not a tidy-up". The code agrees: `evaluate()` (`:251-288`) computes `missingWatched` and yields `drifted`, `exitCodeFor('drifted')` is `EXIT_OK` (`:209-213`), and `renderReading` prints "No longer required: …" for it (`:361`). `PINNED_CONTEXTS` is untouched (`['Type Check']`). Declaring the name also removes it from `unexpected`: before this PR the live read listed it under "Required but not declared here" (`:364`), a list that a loss from the ruleset would have shortened without naming anything — which is the gain the triage note asked the seat to measure.

**(e) Every factual sentence the diff adds — TRUE against the tree, the ruleset and the rulings.**
- Doc inventory row (`content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md:46`): "Yes" in the "Blocks a PR?" column — the ruleset requires it; "the maintainer enrolled the context under #9969's ruling A" — `5852129691` and the live read; "`scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` declares it in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`, so a Dependabot bump waits for it too" — `:242` and (c).
- Doc section (`:2064-2076`): readable by `check-required-check-set.mjs` and writable by nothing in the tree — `fetchRules` is one GET and the script never writes; "unfiltered on `pull_request`, subscribed to `merge_group`, no `continue-on-error`" — yml `:72-77`, and no such key exists; "its first run was red on one objectui file over an objectstack commit" — the workflow's only run of 2026-09-18 (35346702279) concluded `failure`, and its annotations name exactly one objectui source path, `src/utils/normalize-list-view.ts:205` (TS2353 on `page`, "compiled against @objectstack/spec …"); "the in-tree half of that action came second" — true by the dates in (a); "reads check runs and never the ruleset" — `createChecksApi`; "the order could not let a red through either way" — name-first, the gate refuses (c); ruleset-first, `strict` required checks block GitHub's own mergeability and the queue build, and 0 Dependabot PRs were open in the window; "watches it, and reports its loss in the patrol's run summary without failing" — (d), and `required-check-set-patrol.yml:164` appends the reading to `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`.
- Gate script prose (`scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs:159`, `:221-241`): the inventory row belongs under "no trigger-level path filter" — true; (1) enrolment in ruleset 11776024 read back 2026-09-27 and recorded on #9969 — true, and "no decision in this file turns on what the ruleset says" — true; (2) `success` on `main` on 2026-09-27, re-derived on every queue build — true, (b) and the `merge_group` subscription; the 2026-09-18 first run red on one objectui file for a spec change made in objectstack — true, annotations above; "stricter than the queue, never looser" — true per (c).
- Patrol prose (`scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs:182-188`): a ruling not an endpoint reading; moved into `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` in the same change; printed "required but not declared" before; a loss would have named nothing; watched not pinned — all true, `renderReading:364` prints exactly that category.

### ② Semver level
None owed, and the PR complies. `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (header, "What is guarded") guards the published, executable source of the packages in the `fixed` group of `.changeset/config.json` — each package's `src/` tree, its `index.html`, and the roots its `files` list publishes — and nothing else. This PR touches `scripts/**`, `scripts/__tests__/**` and `content/docs/guide/**` only: no package source, no published contract, so no `.changeset/*.md` is due and none was added. The head's `Changeset Declaration` check-run is `success`.

### ③ Boundary flags
- `.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml:36` (section heading "…although this context is NOT required yet"), `:44` ("This context is REQUIRABLE, and it is not REQUIRED"), `:46-48` ("classifies it, with the reason, in `NOT_A_GATE` until a maintainer enrols it there; moving the name to `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` in that file is the in-tree half of the same action"), `:49` ("Nothing here claims the check is required"). Lines 36 and 44 were falsified by the enrolment and are already false at `origin/main`; lines 46-47 are falsified by this PR. Named in the PR's Acceptance notes; `.github/workflows/**` was outside the dispatch's file surface, and `spec-main-shape-gate.test.ts` pins only requirability, not this prose. Flagged for the seat; carrier: none.
- `AGENTS.md`: carries no statement about `Spec Main Shape Gate`; `:347` says the ruleset's required-checks list is not written in-repo — unaffected. `:545` (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` 「只报告、不拦截」) is stale against the ruleset, but by the maintainer's enrolment of that other context, not by this PR; governed surface, out of scope.
- Other docs pages: `Spec Main Shape Gate` appears in no `content/docs` file other than `ci-cd-pipeline.md`, and no other page lists the required checks. Nothing newly false.
- Pre-existing stale counts this PR leaves as they were (already false at `origin/main`, still false; observations, not defects of this change): `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md:2850,2853,2855` ("`WATCHED_CONTEXTS` is the other eight", "the nine to pin", "any of the eight" — it is 1 pinned + 6 watched now); `:2965-2968` enumerates the declared set as Test, Type Check, Lint, Build & E2E, Build Docs "and the five one-`node`-call gates" (the list holds 23 names); `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs:19-20,70,111-112,154` ("nine contexts", "eight watched", "one name and not nine"); `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs:173-175` ("The four shards are spelled out individually on purpose").
- Closing keyword: the body's only closing reference is `Fixes #9969`. Correct.
- Check results at head: 40 check-runs, 37 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard …)`, `dependabot` — non-gates by design), 0 failed; each of the 8 ruleset contexts is `success`. The PR is a draft with assignee `os-steve`; its single commit carries a model-named `Co-Authored-By` trailer, which the seat's report already flags for the squash message.
